name: MINOX
recent: Minox 在 2026 年 11 月 23 日公布季度业绩，录得净利 170 万令吉；董事经理 Cheong Chee Son 在闭市期前申报交易意向，并于 11 月 23 日以每股 0.130 令吉增持 103,800 股。公司也在 10 月及 11 月发布多项企业提案公告。
notable: 董事经理 Cheong Chee Son 在闭市期前申报交易意向，并于 2026 年 11 月 23 日以每股 0.130 令吉增持 103,800 股。
独立非执行董事 Ng Kuan Hua 于 2026 年 9 月 18 日以每股 0.155 令吉增持 22,200 股。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 15 日及 11 月 27 日发布多项企业提案公告。
risks: 董事经理 Cheong Chee Son 在闭市期内进行交易，涉及闭市期交易申报。
公司于 10 月及 11 月发布多项企业提案，具体内容未在公告标题中披露。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 1,008 万令吉，净利 120.5 万令吉，净利率 12.0%；营收环比增长 9.5%，净利环比增长 725.3%；营收同比下滑 11.6%，净利同比下滑 6.2%。

recent_en: Minox reported quarterly profit attributable of RM1.7 million on 23 November 2026; Managing Director Cheong Chee Son declared his intention to deal during the closed period and acquired 103,800 shares at RM0.130 each on 23 November. The company also issued multiple proposals announcements in October and November.
notable_en: Managing Director Cheong Chee Son declared intention to deal during closed period and acquired 103,800 shares at RM0.130 each on 23 November 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Director Ng Kuan Hua acquired 22,200 shares at RM0.155 each on 18 September 2026.
The company issued multiple proposals announcements on 15 October and 27 November 2026.
risks_en: Managing Director Cheong Chee Son traded during the closed period, triggering a closed-period dealings announcement.
The company issued multiple proposals announcements in October and November, with details not disclosed in the announcement titles.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM10.08 million with net income of RM1.205 million and net margin of 12.0%; revenue rose 9.5% QoQ and net income jumped 725.3% QoQ; revenue fell 11.6% YoY and net income declined 6.2% YoY.
